annotation.title_clean: 关于印发《“十四五”噪声污染防治行动计划》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Issuing the "14th Five-Year Plan" Noise Pollution Prevention and Control Action Plan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 生态环境部 et al. (Ministry of Ecology and Environment and other ministries)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of China
annotation.summary_en: Chinese multi-ministry action plan (January 2023) implementing the Noise Pollution Prevention Law for the 14th Five-Year Plan period. It sets noise-source controls for industry, construction, transport and social life, monitoring, standards and enforcement, with a target of 85% night-time compliance of acoustic functional zones by 2025. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Target: 85% night-time compliance of acoustic functional zones nationwide by 2025
Zoning, automatic monitoring networks and noise maps in cities
Discharge permits and key-emitter lists for industrial noise
Stricter construction night-work and low-noise equipment rules
Revise noise standards for products, rail, aircraft and construction
